BiblicalUsage: Pallu, son of Reuben, is the head of the family of the Palluites. His sons are listed among the seventy who go down into Egypt with Jacob, his name stands in the genealogy of Reuben, and his family is counted again in the wilderness census.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Pallu's name lives on in his family: a son of Reuben becomes a clan, and the clan is still counted a generation later.
